authorship.humanDirection: Weekend Ride circuit and open-road roadside ecology for exact Web/Unity reuse

assets.role: alpha-tested roadside foliage and rock billboard atlas
constraints: presentation only; never collision, grip, route, landmark, or scoring authority
one isolated grounded cluster per quadrant
the same atlas regions and physical scale contract must be consumed by Web and Unity
sRGB color with alpha-tested foliage; mipmaps must not restore the blue source matte
no identifiable real-world location, sign, brand, person, or vehicle
assets.prompt: Create a production-ready square 2x2 sprite atlas for a realistic Australian-style weekend motorcycle hinterland environment. Top-left: broad-canopy eucalyptus tree cluster with readable trunks and irregular crown. Top-right: tall dry roadside grass and reeds. Bottom-left: mixed native scrub and low shrubs. Bottom-right: weathered warm-grey sandstone boulder and small rock cluster with dry grass. Each subject is centered and grounded within its cell, isolated, naturally lit, and uses a coherent muted olive/ochre palette. The final source plate uses a perfectly flat pure blue chroma background, no grid, labels, borders, ground plane, cast shadows, or quadrant crossing.

source.modelBackend: OpenAI built-in image generation; exact backend and seed not exposed
